scope: Independent exact-string and aggregation-contract validation; no targets were read

run_level.zero_r2_denominator: If sum_{i=1..N}((y_i - mean(y))^2) is zero, record r2 as null/undefined; do not substitute zero.

design_level.zero_r2_denominator: If the design-level R2 denominator is zero, record r2 as null/undefined; do not substitute zero.

residuals.denominator: N; population standard deviation, not sample standard deviation

bootstrap.retention_rule: For each selected design occurrence, retain all five realization rows belonging to that design; repeated selections retain repeated copies of all five rows.
bootstrap.undefined_r2_rule: A replicate with a zero R2 denominator has r2=null/undefined. Exclude only undefined R2 replicates from R2 percentile calculation; do not exclude them from RMSE or MAE calculations.
bootstrap.r2_replicate_counts: Report the number of defined R2 replicates and the number of undefined R2 replicates.

record_ordering: Emit run-level prediction-versus-actual and residual records in ascending design_id, then ascending realization_id, then ascending run_id. Emit design-level records in ascending design_id.
